min_standing_note.value: Home nomination and competitive application review required; BA exchange students can only be nominated for Winter + Spring terms combined, not Spring-only.
min_standing_note.notes: 2025-2026 fact sheet page 1 explicitly states BA students can only apply for Winter + Spring combined; asterisk retained in 2026-2027 fact sheet page 1.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Agreement scope is Political science (UG, Fall/Spring), hosted in HUSS at AUC.

eligible_majors.notes: Partner list row 17 restricts scope to Political science.

instruction_languages.notes: English is the working and instructional language at CEU.

english_course_availability.notes: All listed CEU courses are taught in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2–C1 English expected (C1 cited on 2025-2026 sheet); TOEFL/IELTS/Cambridge or home institution CEFR confirmation letter; native speakers and graduates of fully English-taught BA/MA programs are exempt.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: 2026-2027 fact sheet page 1 specifies B2–C1 expected; 2025-2026 fact sheet page 2 details exemptions.

host_language_requirement.value: None required (English is the working language; optional free German courses offered).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall: Mandatory Orientation Week Aug 31 – Sep 5, 2026; Fall Term Sep – Dec 2026.
fall_term_dates.notes: 2026-2027 fact sheet page 1 and https://www.ceu.edu/orientation give Aug 31 – Sep 5, 2026 orientation week.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Winter Term Jan – Mar 2027; Spring Term Apr – Jun 2027 (BA exchange students must take Winter + Spring combined).
spring_term_dates.notes: 2025-2026 fact sheet page 1 confirms BA students cannot apply for Spring term alone.

tuition_model.notes: Reciprocal exchange students continue paying home tuition and are exempt from CEU tuition.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2025-2026 fact sheet page 2 estimates 1,000 EUR/month living expenses in Vienna; 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2 links https://www.ceu.edu/student-life/arriving/cost-of-living.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: 1000 EUR/month * 5 months * 1.1052 = 5526.00 USD using ECB 2026-11-13 rate (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Austrian Student Union (ÖH) fee 26.20 EUR/semester (52.40 EUR/year); mandatory health insurance required (EHIC for EU/EEA or MA35-compliant Austrian insurance for non-EU/EEA).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: ÖH fee from CEU Tuition & Fees page; health insurance rules from 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2.

housing_availability.notes: 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2 states 'CEU does not operate dormitories'; housing FAQ: https://www.ceu.edu/student-life/arriving/accommodation/faq.

housing_notes.value: CEU does not operate dormitories; incoming students arrange private/student housing in Vienna via guidance at https://www.ceu.edu/student-life/arriving/accommodation/faq.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA stays over 90 days require Visa D (up to 6 months) or Student Residence Permit; Austrian financial proof thresholds: 533.85 EUR/month (under 24) or 966.65 EUR/month (24+), plus rent exceeding 299.95 EUR/month.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: URL linked from 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2 visa section.

course_catalog_url.notes: URL recovered from PDF hyperlink annotation on 2026-2027 fact sheet page 1.

credit_system_and_load.value: Dual US credit and ECTS system (1 US credit = 2 ECTS); grading scale A (3.67+) down to C+ (2.33 minimum pass), F (0).
credit_system_and_load.notes: Credit conversion from CEU Catalog Annex 6; grading scale from 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2.

course_restrictions_note.value: Exchange students must take at least 50% of courses/ECTS in their host department; BA students cannot enroll for Spring term alone without Winter term.
course_restrictions_note.notes: 50% host-department rule on 2026-2027 fact sheet page 1; Winter+Spring rule on 2025-2026 fact sheet page 1.

value: Proof of English proficiency (or CEFR letter)

academic_style.notes: US-accredited institution issuing US credit hours (dual with ECTS) and A–F letter grades.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory Orientation Week, Student Life Office visa/residence assistance, Academic Support, Counseling, Career Services, Disability Rights Officer, and free German classes.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall: Nomination Apr 15 / Application Apr 30; Winter & Spring: Nomination Oct 15 / Application Oct 30.
